ns2:course.label: Electric Violin
ns2:course.description: Instruction in electric violin at the undergraduate level. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course. Music majors must register concurrently in an approved ensemble.
